hello: Explain middleware in one short sentence.

poll: Poll job DEMO-42 until it is complete.
pages: Fetch pages starting at cursor 0 until done is true.

claude_bash: Use bash once to run python -c "print(6 * 7)" and report the output.

claude_memory_write: Use the memory tool to store this preference in /memories/preferences.txt: concise explanations in Polish.
claude_memory_read: Use the memory tool to read /memories/preferences.txt and report the stored preference.
